mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.code, a.name, a.provider, a.sandbox, a.api_base_url, a.currency, a.status, a.auto_sync, a.stock_sync_time, a.fee_sync_time, a.last_error, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_time, CASE WHEN a.credentials IS NULL OR a.credentials = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_credentials, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_owh_warehouse w WHERE w.account_id = a.id) AS warehouse_count FROM ecom_owh_account a
AND (a.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND a.provider = #{provider} AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY a.id
